3: Let my prayer come in before you; incline your ear to my supplication, O Lord.
4: For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has drawn near to Hades.
5: I have been reckoned with them that go down to the pit; I became as a man without help;
6: free among the dead, as the slain ones cast out, who sleep in the tomb; whom you remember no more; and they are rejected from your hand.
7: They laid me in the lowest pit, in dark [places], and in the shadow of death.
8: Your wrath has pressed heavily upon me, and you have brought upon me all your billows. Pause.
9: You have removed my acquaintance far from me; they have made me an abomination to themselves; I have been delivered up, and have not gone forth.
10: My eyes are dimmed from poverty; but I cried to you, O Lord, all the day; I spread forth my hands to you.
11: Will you work wonders for the dead? or shall physicians raise [them] up, that they shall praise you?
12: Shall any one declare your mercy in the tomb? and your truth in destruction?
13: Shall your wonders be known in darkness? and your righteousness in a forgotten land?
14: But I cried to you, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent you.
15: Therefore, O Lord, do you reject my prayer, [and] turn your face away from me?
16: I am poor and in troubles from my youth; and having been exalted, I was brought low and into despair.
17: Your wrath has passed over me; and your terrors have greatly disquieted me.
18: They compassed me like water; all the day they beset me together.
19: You have put far from me [every] friend, and my acquaintances because of [my] wretchedness.
